### **SW-REQ-BARO-APP-001** — Execute Barometer App at 20 Hz

- **Description:** The baro app shall execute at 20 Hz on the static schedule throughout the mission.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-008; system-mandated 20 Hz altimeter sample rate is realized by scheduling the baro app at 20 Hz.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-008
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-APP-002** — Acquire One Sample Each Cycle

- **Description:** The baro app shall acquire one barometer sample on each scheduled execution.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-008; per-cycle sample acquisition realizes the 20 Hz altimeter sample cadence.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active

- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-APP-003** — Publish Barometer Message on Software Bus

- **Description:** The baro app shall publish a barometer message on the software bus on each scheduled execution.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-001; raw baro samples reach the logging path via a software bus message published by the baro app.
